point: 提出一种基于最大熵 RL 的样本高效深度 RL 算法,几乎不需要逐任务调参,只用少量试次就能学到神经网络策略。
quote_en: we propose a sample-efficient deep RL algorithm based on maximum entropy RL that requires minimal per-task tuning and only a modest number of trials to learn neural network policies

point: 在真实 Minitaur 机器人上,直接在现实世界从零学到稳定步态,约两小时,不依赖任何模型或仿真。
quote_en: Our method can acquire a stable gait from scratch directly in the real world in about two hours, without relying on any model or simulation, and the resulting policy is robust to moderate variations in the environment

point: 在仿真基准上用同一套超参数达到当时最优性能。
quote_en: our algorithm achieves state-of-the-art performance on simulated benchmarks with a single set of hyperparameters

point: 核心是对 soft actor-critic 的扩展,去掉了人工调温度参数的需要,改为用基于梯度的优化把温度推向对已访问状态的目标期望熵。
quote_en: Our method employs gradient-based optimization of the temperature towards the targeted expected entropy over the visited states

point: 只约束对状态的期望熵,逐状态的熵仍可变化——让策略在确定性更优的状态自动降熵、其余状态仍保持随机。
quote_en: our method controls only the expected entropy over the states, while the per-state entropy can still vary

point: 主要贡献是一套面向物理机器人腿式运动的端到端 RL 框架,包含基于最大熵 RL 的数据高效学习算法和一个异步学习系统。
quote_en: The principal contribution of our paper is an end-to-end RL framework for legged locomotion on physical robots, which includes a data efficient learning algorithm based on maximum entropy RL and an asynchronous learning system

point: 真实机器人训练约需 400 个 rollout,约合两小时现实时间。
quote_en: The training requires about 400 rollouts, equating to about two hours of real-world time

point: 异步学习系统由三部分组成:采集机器人经验的数据采集任务、用动捕计算奖励的动作捕捉任务、更新神经网络的训练任务,三者在不同机器上异步运行。
quote_en: consists of three components: a data collection job that collects robot experience, a motion capture job that computes the reward signal based on robot's position measured by a motion capture system, and a training job that updates the neural networks

point: 最大熵 RL 目标在期望回报上加上策略熵项(温度 α 权衡两者),α→0 时退化为常规 RL。
quote_en: controls the stochasticity of the optimal policy

point: 把问题写成带最小期望熵约束的约束优化(公式2),并对其拉格朗日松弛(公式3)用对偶梯度法求解,对偶变量即扮演温度的角色。
quote_en: the dual variable takes the role of the temperature

point: 温度沿(3)负梯度方向更新,以满足熵约束。
quote_en: We can optimize the temperature by moving it in the direction of the negative gradient of (3)

point: 实践中用高斯策略 + 两个参数化 Q 函数(θ1,θ2),Q 损失为对回归目标的均方误差(公式8)。
quote_en: We additionally use two parameterized Q-functions, with parameters

point: 用重参数化技巧最小化策略目标(公式9),整套流程与标准 SAC 相同,只是温度是显式、动态的。
quote_en: This procedure is the same as the standard soft actor-critic algorithm [17], but with an explicit, dynamic temperature

point: 为保证温度非负,实际把 α 参数化为 exp(β) 并优化 β。
quote_en: we thus parameterize

point: 对偶部分用截断的对偶梯度下降近似:不优化到收敛,而是对每个目标各走一步、交替进行。
quote_en: performs incomplete optimization

point: 仿真基准上所有算法用相同网络结构:两层、每层256隐藏单元,用 ADAM、统一学习率 0.0003。
quote_en: two-layer neural network with 256 hidden units on each layer, and we use ADAM [27] with the same learning rate of 0.0003

point: 本方法把目标熵设为每个动作维度 -1(故 HalfCheetah 目标熵 -6,Humanoid 用 -17)。
quote_en: we simply set the target entropy to be -1 per action dimension (i.e., HalfCheetah has target entropy -6, while Humanoid uses -17)

point: 在四个 OpenAI Gym 连续运动基准上,本方法性能与逐环境调参的标准 SAC 几乎相同或更好,并整体优于或相当于 DDPG/TD3/PPO。
quote_en: Overall, our method performs better or comparably to the other baselines, standard SAC, DDPG, TD3, and PPO

point: 标准 SAC 对奖励尺度敏感:各基准环境在大致 1 到 10 这一同样区间表现好,但仿真 Minitaur 需要大约高两个数量级的奖励尺度才能工作。
quote_en: All benchmark environments achieve good performance for about the same range of values, between 1 to 10. On the other hand, the simulated Minitaur requires roughly two orders of magnitude larger reward scale to work properly

point: 本方法对目标熵这一超参数明显更不敏感:好的目标熵取值范围在所有环境下基本一致。
quote_en: the range of good target entropy values is essentially the same for all environments, making hyperparameter tuning substantially less laborious

point: 本方法能在较少步数内把熵收敛到目标值,而固定温度的常规 SAC 熵随 Q 增大而缓慢下降。
quote_en: our algorithm is able to match the target entropy in a relatively small number of steps. On the other hand, regular SAC has a fixed temperature parameter and thus the entropy slowly decreases as the Q-function increases

point: 在仿真 Minitaur 上本方法是最数据高效的;且要得到固定温度 SAC 的结果须扫一组候选温度选最好,等价于多采约一个数量级的样本。
quote_en: Our method is the most data efficient. Note that in order to obtain the result of SAC (fixed temperature) in the plot, we had to sweep though a set of candidate temperatures and choose the best one. This mandatory hyperparameter tuning is equivalent to collecting an order of magnitude more samples

point: 仿真中算法通过维持较高策略熵,有效逃出'向前扑倒'这一常见跌倒/早停局部极小。
quote_en: our algorithm effectively escapes a local minimum of “diving forward,” which is a common cause of falling and early episode termination, by maintaining the policy entropy at higher values

point: 仿真机器人能承受最高 220N 的侧向推力并恢复正常行走,显著大于在1000次学习试次中挑出的最佳 PPO 策略的 130N。
quote_en: the simulated robot can withstand up to 220N lateral pushes and subsequently recover to normal walking. This is significantly larger than the maximum 130N of the best PPO-trained policy that is picked out of 1000 learning trials

point: 真机 MDP 观测包含 8 个电机角、横滚和俯仰角及其角速度;排除 yaw 因其漂移快。
quote_en: the observation includes eight motor angles, roll and pitch angles, and their angular velocities. We choose to exclude the yaw measurement because it drifts quickly

point: 为安全用低 PD 增益 kp=0.3、kd=0.003 保证柔顺;并因延迟与部分观测的非马尔可夫性,把最近5步观测和动作的历史并入观测,得到112维观测空间。
quote_en: augment an observation space to include a history of the last five observations and actions which results in a 112 dimensional observation space

point: 奖励鼓励更长行走距离(用动捕测),并惩罚大的关节加速度、过大的横滚角以及前腿折叠;权重设为 1.0、0.05、0.5、1.0,角度阈值设为 0.3 弧度。
quote_en: The weights are set to 1.0, 0.05, 0.5, 1.0 respectively and the maximum angle threshold q is set to 0.3 radians

point: 策略和价值函数用两隐藏层、每层256神经元的全连接前馈网络;前50个episode平滑动作以防早期抖动。
quote_en: fully connected feed-forward neural networks with two hidden-layers and 256 neurons per layer, which are randomly initialized. For preventing too jerky motions at the early stage, we smoothed out actions for the first 50 episodes

point: 真机在16万控制步(约400 rollout)学会行走;每个 rollout 最长500步(合10秒),摔倒可早停;整个训练约两小时。
quote_en: Our method successfully learns to walk from 160k control steps, or approximately 400 rollouts. Each rollout has the maximum length of 500 steps (equivalent to 10 seconds) and can terminate early if the robot falls

point: 训练好的机器人以约 0.32 m/s(约0.8倍体长/秒)前进;学到的步态周期同步,但系统中未编码任何轨迹生成器、对称或周期约束。
quote_en: Note that the learned gait is periodic and synchronized, though no explicit trajectory generator, symmetry constraint, or periodicity constraint is encoded into the system

point: 对外部扰动鲁棒:向后/侧向推机器人基座,虽训练时从未遇到此类扰动,10次重复测试都恢复到周期步态。
quote_en: Although the policy has never been trained with such perturbations, it successfully recovered and returned to a periodic gait for all 10 repeated tests

point: 仅在平地训练,却能泛化到未见地形:上下坡、撞过木块障碍、下台阶;重复测试10次全部成功。
quote_en: The robot is able to walk up and down a slope (second row), ram through an obstacle made of wooden blocks (third row), and step down stairs (fourth row) without difficulty, despite not being trained in these settings. We repeated these tests for 10 times, and the robot succeeds on all cases

point: 作者声称这是据其所知首个把深度 RL 直接应用于真实世界四足运动、无需任何仿真预训练的例子。
quote_en: To the best of our knowledge, our experiment is the first example of an application of deep reinforcement learning to quadrupedal locomotion directly on a robot in the real world without any pretraining in the simulation

point: 作者自述当前系统两大关键未解难题:严重依赖回合间人工复位,以及缺乏可让更大机器人安全学习的安全层。
quote_en: Two of the most critical remaining challenges of our current system are the heavy dependency on manual resets between episodes and the lack of a safety layer that would enable learning on bigger robots
